products.name: Ms. Martinson's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: Wildlife of the PNW: A Student Collection Students in Ms. Martinson’s class were asked to draw their favorite Pacific Northwest animals. Their submissions—including drawings of the killer whale, birds, turtles, marmots, frogs, snakes, pigeons, and the wolf—were first hand-drawn in Sharpie, then digitally arranged into this graphic compilation. This artwork represents the diverse wildlife of our area and captures each child’s unique interpretation of these animals. The artwork is in a black metallic frame (not shown). Volunteer: Brianna Home

products.name: Ms. Stump's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: Botanical and Avian Studies: Echoes of the 1800s Inspired by historical botanical and bird illustrations from the 1800s—a style used for scientific depictions before photography was common—Ms. Stump’s students created unique artwork of birds and flowers. Using pencil and watercolor pencil, each student captured their subject. The resulting drawings and paintings were compiled digitally into a piece that is framed and ready to hang. Volunteers: Brianna Home & Lydia Bassis

products.name: Teacher Margaret/Mr. Strasner's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: Stick with Me Driftwood sticks collected on Washington beaches have been transformed into this breathtaking and colorful wreath by Montlake artists. This wreath celebrates the best of the Pacific Northwest: Driftwood! Whales! Soccer! Taylor Swift! Montlake! Hang this stunner on your door and bring joy to all who enter! Volunteer: Aisling Kerins

products.name: Ms. Podney’s Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: We see the same stars (octahedra constellation) We see the same stars (octahedra constellation, 2026) is a sculpture created by students in Ms. Podney’s first-grade class in collaboration with Ben and Gennie Brady. Each panel was created by a student and attached to the frame, which is formed by multiple octahedra. This work highlights what we all share together and asks what connections can be made if we give ourselves the time and space to do so. The artists invite the viewer to take in the individual beauty of each child’s imagination, while reflecting on our shared experience of awe and wonder when gazing up at the stars. Volunteers: Ben & Gennie Brady

products.name: Mr. B's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: Montlake Mosaic Created by the students of Mr. B’s Kindergarten class, Montlake Mosaic celebrates the people, places, and natural beauty that make our neighborhood special. Each tile is an individual artist’s interpretation of community—from flowers and trees to homes, animals, and playgrounds. Together, these unique pieces form a colorful portrait of Montlake as seen through the eyes of its youngest residents. Volunteers: Christina Dunlop & Lana Stojcic

products.name: Mr. Azer's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: Azer Alps After a delightfully hectic spring, our fourth and fifth graders created a moment of calm through Zen Doodle Mountains—a collaborative landscape filled with intricate patterns, mindful lines, and student-designed details. This one-of-a-kind original artwork brings a peaceful, conversation-starting focal point to any home or office. Take home the mountain they built together. Volunteers: Annie Vithayathil and Jennifer Thuwirat Dimensions: 24"x20”

products.name: Mrs. Orse's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: KinderGARDEN Behold the vibrant colors of Mrs. Orse's blooming KinderGARDEN, in all its springtime glory. Our little seedlings melded their artistic and scientific tendencies by pipetting liquid watercolor onto diffusion paper and sprinkling in some acrylics just for fun. Chaos was sewn liberally, and the garden that emerged on canvas can now grace your walls and remind you of the tremendous growth these kids have shown in their first year at Montlake! Please water copiously (with raffle tickets) to keep these flowers bright! Volunteers: Ana Torvie Dimensions: 15”x30”

products.name: Mr. Marshall's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: Sierra Marshall Mountains After a delightfully hectic spring, our fourth and fifth graders created a moment of calm through Zen Doodle Mountains—a collaborative landscape filled with intricate patterns, mindful lines, and student-designed details. This one-of-a-kind original artwork  brings a peaceful, conversation-starting focal point to any home or office. Take home the mountain they built together.

products.name: Ms. Stryker's Class Artwork – Raffle Ticket
products.description: The Run A true celebration of creativity and teamwork, this one-of-a-kind piece was created by the talented artists of Ms. Stryker's class. Each student began by hand-drawing their own salmon. Using elements from every child's artwork, parent volunteer Megan Emslie thoughtfully combined the individual drawings into a single collaborative salmon line drawing.  The class then embarked on an exciting artistic journey through watercolor painting and screen printing. After adding vibrant watercolor backgrounds, the students learned a new printmaking technique and screen-printed the collaborative salmon image over their paintings, bringing the final design to life.  The result is a stunning work of art that captures the spirit, creativity, and teamwork of Ms. Stryker's classroom. More than just a beautiful piece, it represents a memorable exploration of color and printmaking for these young artists. Volunteer: Megan Emslie
